svg.text: ROUND 351 · MULTI-LORA CPU-TO-GPU ADAPTER PAGING & STAGE-BEFORE-ADMIT ASYNC PREFETCH
Why Cold LoRA Swaps Stall Active Decode Batches 64ms & How Stage-Before-Admit Cuts It 800x
Provenance: synthetic + anonymized_reported (independently_reproduced=false, physical_gpu_cluster_measurement=not_measured)
⛔ Trap 1 & 2: 64ms Head-of-Line Decode Stall & Churn
1. Admitting Cold LoRA Request Before H2D Staging (64.0 ms!)
• Request #256 needs `LoRA #42` (`r=64`, `320 MB`), missing in GPU slots
• Synchronous load on `compute_stream` freezes all 255 active requests!
TPOT spikes 5.5x (14.2 ms -> 78.2 ms) on every cold adapter swap!
2. Pageable RAM Copy & FIFO Active-Set Thrashing
• Pageable `torch.load` cannot use direct DMA (5.0 GB/s vs 54.0 GB/s)
• Scheduling 16 active LoRAs with `max_loras=8` swaps on EVERY step!
Even pinned copy on `compute_stream` adds 11.5 ms blocking stall!
Net Impact of Synchronous Multi-LoRA Paging:
64.00 ms Decode Freeze · 78.20 ms P99 TPOT · Broken CUDAGraph
1 cold-adapter request degrades SLA for all 255 warm-adapter users
🏆 Tier 4: Pinned LRU + Stage-Before-Admit Async DMA
1. "Stage-Before-Admit" on Dedicated `lora_h2d_stream` (0.08 ms)
• Keep cold request in `STAGING_LORA` while DMA copies from Pinned RAM
• 255 active requests run decode on `compute_stream` with ZERO wait!
Admit request on next step once `cudaEventQuery(lora_evt) == cudaSuccess`!
2. Pinned Host Tier (`max_cpu_loras=64`) + Affinity Grouping
• Pre-stage hot adapters in `cudaHostAlloc` pinned RAM (54.0 GB/s DMA)
• Cap concurrent active adapters per batch at `<= max_loras` (0 thrash)!
In-place slot update preserves fixed GPU pointers for `CUDAGraph`!
Production Verification Summary (70B, r=64, 320 MB/LoRA):
0.08 ms Decode Stall (800.0x Lower) · 14.28 ms P99 TPOT · 54 GB/s DMA
100% isolation between cold-adapter staging and warm-adapter decoding
Key Takeaway: Never admit a cold-LoRA request into the running batch before its weights finish async DMA into a GPU slot.
